title: item catalogue
description: protocol/items.json, the canonical items of the one trainer economy (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.9, MG6): every item the ledger can hold, its class, the Cobblemon item it is mirrored as (when it is), the move a machine teaches (TMs cross by move), and each game's symbol for it. Items a game lacks have no symbol for it; class key never crosses (key items, HMs, badges, story items). Copied into the fabric-bridge jar and generated into gen1-bridge/lib/kb_items.lua. Ids and symbols only, never game content.

class.description: ball, medicine, battle (X items), field (repels, ropes, dolls), stone (evolution stones), held (Gen 2+), valuable, tm (crosses by move), key (never crosses).

cobblemon.description: The Cobblemon item path (namespace cobblemon) the Minecraft mirror creates for it; absent = never mirrored (ledger only).

move.description: tm/hm: the move taught, as its national (Showdown) move number; TMs match across games by it.

symbols.description: Per family, the engine's item symbol (gen1: the import's ids, e.g. POTION, TM_MEGA_PUNCH; gen3 filled in with its adapter).
